run_voc_from_imagenet: run the script to generate a COCO-style JSON file mapping ImageNet classes to VOC categories
build_voc_categories_mapping: build a VOC-style category list mapping 20 Pascal VOC classes to their ImageNet WNID ranges
create_imagenet_image_info: create an image info JSON file from ImageNet training data filtered by VOC category and image dimensions
test_voc_categories: test the voc_categories list to verify each VOC class maps to valid ImageNet WNID ranges
review_voc_from_imagenet: review the voc_from_imagenet script to understand how it generates COCO-format image info from ImageNet
